fields.statement: At 5afc8275d, under flock and the systemd-run cap: go test -count=1 -race -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestScaledClock|TestTimedOut|TestWait' exit 0 (9.4s; all 19 tests pass, incl. TestWaitTimesOut, TestWaitSleepsOnlyToDeadline, TestWaitBackoffStopsAtTimeout unchanged on fakeClock); go vet ./internal/run exit 0. Diff read: clock.go's Sleep waits max(d/n, min(d,50ms)) and adds only skipped time to Now under a mutex (scaled-sleep-real-poll-floor, scaled-clock-now-skips-sleeps); Wait.TimedOut is exact on non-scaled clocks and adds the min(timeout,3s) real floor on ScaledClock; engine wait() uses it and sleeps its interval past the deadline. Tests cover Sleep(30s) in [50ms,100ms) with Now +30s, Sleep(50ms) ~50ms, 50ms of real time ~50ms of Now, concurrency under -race, ''/unset/0/-5/1.5/abc giving RealClock, the 10m/1s timeout floors, fake/RealClock exact, engine wait passing after 1s real and timing out in [3s,4s). RealClock, the nil-Clock default, workflow intervals and engine_test.go untouched; no TODOs. The full-package run, rhiza ship generate and rhiza render from Checks were not re-run: the brief limits the run to the named tests, and a verifier does not write files.
